sentences.text:
Appellant's first appeal was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed with liberty to renew the prayer for bail after receipt of DNA report or prosecutrix evidence before the trial Court vide order dated 12.09.2023 passed in Cr.A.No.10836 of 2023.
3.

As per the prosecution story, on 02.07.2023, 25 year old prosecutrix lodged FIR alleging that on 30.06.2023 at around 12 o' clock of the day she along with her sister-in-law had gone to answer call of nature in Kuddu Darji's agricultural field where his house is built.
She was called by Kuddu's mother.
When she reached there Gokul Lodhi forcibly took her in a room and committed rape.
FIR was registered almost after three days of the incident.
4. Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that appellant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
Prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court.
She has not supported the prosecution story.
Therefore, it is prayed that appellant may be released on bail.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
6. In this case, prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court.
She has not supported the prosecution story.

Therefore, having taken into consideration the prosecutrix's deposition before the trial Court and other facts and circumstances of the case but without expressing any opinion on merit of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pretrial detention of the appellant is not warranted.
Consequently, this appeal under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 is allowed.
Impugned order is set aside.

7. It is directed that appellant - Gokal @ Toota Singh be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
